description: Agent Uncertainty: submit the estimates in one work product: each estimate with its id, what is estimated, the single figure given, the low and high bounds of its range, the unit, the figure as written (such as 1,234,567 units or 1.2 million), why the bounds sit where they do as stated, and the evidence behind it (strong, moderate or thin). The signed report gives every estimate with its range, its width as a share of its midpoint, the precision its written figure claims and its status as sound, point_only, too_narrow, bounds_unreasoned, overstated_precision, too_wide or unconfirmed, counts the ranges, single figures and reasoned bounds, and gives the width rules, and names estimates that claim more precision than they have: a single figure with no range, and a range narrower than its evidence supports (at least 50% of its midpoint on thin evidence and 20% on moderate evidence); then bounds with no stated reasoning, a figure written finer than one hundredth of its range, and a range wider than 100% of its midpoint on strong evidence, with the fix for each. This reads the honesty of the ranges an agent gives, not whether the figures are right: whether a benchmark claim’s figures appear in its cited source is wever_benchmark-evidence-check, and the spread around an evaluation’s measured results is wever_evaluation-result-check. Verdict estimates_falsely_precise, estimate_range_gaps, estimate_range_unverified or estimate_ranges_sound. POST /api/uncertainty-range-check. Reads only the recorded work product and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no answer is changed, no source is fetched and no party is contacted. Agent Uncertainty reads the uncertainty an agent carries in its own work products and answers, its stated confidence, what it does not know and what it assumed: it is not formal scoring of outputs against rubrics, datasets and benchmarks (the wever_evaluation checks), not grading the source material itself (wever_claim-evidence-check, wever_data-evidence-check and the other evidence checks), not traces, metrics and runtime behavior (the wever_observability checks) and not the loop around feedback received (the wever_feedback checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-uncertainty-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-uncertainty/.

as_written.description: The figure as written, such as 1,234,567 units.

evidence.description: The evidence behind it: strong, moderate or thin.

id.description: The estimate id, such as e1.

quantity.description: What is estimated, such as Q4 unit demand.

reasoning.description: Why the bounds sit where they do, as stated.

unit.description: The unit, such as units or USD.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
